jobs.title: Tooling specialist (Press tools)
jobs.desc:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

 This Position reports to:
Production Engineering Manager 

 What we believe in 

 At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

 Your role and responsibilities 

 In this role, you will have the opportunity to Optimizes the Production organization's assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety.
 The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

 As a Tooling Specialist, you will support for ABB India – Electrification, Smart Power Business to be based at Nelamangala – Bangalore.

 You will be mainly accountable for: 

 • Material & Process Knowledge: Extensive knowledge of ferrous, non-ferrous, and insulation materials, with practical experience in sheet-metal and non-ferrous stamping, hot/cold forging, machining, assemblies, heat treatment, and surface treatment processes.

• Tooling & Manufacturing Development: Oversee development and validation of press tools, molds, gauges, fixtures, and sub-assemblies; review DFM and ensure tooling meets required standards for precision, durability, quality, and manufacturability.

• Supplier Development & Localization: Identify and develop suitable Indian suppliers, lead part localization based on engineering drawings and specifications, and coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely development and regular supply of critical parts.

• Quality & Engineering Validation: Conduct PPAP, joint inspections, sampling inspections, tooling trials, and dimensional/process validation; collaborate with Global/US Engineering and Quality teams to validate critical components and close technical issues.

• Project, Cost & Stakeholder Management: Manage cost-saving initiatives, monitor project milestones and development timelines, provide biweekly management updates, and ensure effective execution of supplier development projects within defined cost, quality, and delivery targets. Exposure to Low Voltage Electrical Switchgear and plastic mold development.

 Qualifications for the role: 

 • Educational Qualification: Diploma in Tool & Die Making from reputed institutions such as NTTF, GTTC, CTTC, or equivalent tooling institutes; alternatively, a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with relevant experience.

• Relevant Experience: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in press tool development, sheet metal component development, and tooling-related activities.

• Engineering Drawing Skills: Solid ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering drawings, specifications, and technical requirements.

• CAD & Modelling Skills: Practical experience in 3D solid modelling and AutoCAD, with the ability to support tooling and component development activities.

• Communication Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively coordinate with suppliers, engineering teams, and other stakeholders.

• Global Team Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with US and international teams across different time zones, while demonstrating effective teamwork and collaboration skills.

• Travel & Teamwork: Willingness to travel extensively across India and visit supplier locations to support tooling and component development, resolve issues, and ensure timely project completion; should work well with others.

 More about us 

 ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. 

 Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

 Recruitment Fraud Warning
 ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

 View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home 

 For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

jobs.desc:
What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

 Group Summary: 
 As an engineering and manufacturing partner, Magna’s Complete Vehicle group helps traditional OEMs and new entrants to bring their automotive visions to life. At Magna, you will work in an innovative, international and dynamic team, always pursuing the goal of delivering high-quality products. We work in a diverse environment with global development opportunities. Together with our employees we constantly strive to create a better world of mobility.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 Design Engineer - Body Structures (BIW) 

 Role Purpose: 
 Responsible for designing and developing Body in White (BIW) components that meet performance, cost, and manufacturing goals. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, production-ready solutions with a focus on structural integrity, efficiency, and compliance.

 Reporting to​: Assistant Manager/ Manager/Group lead

 Responsibilities/ task: 
 • Design and development of BIW structures including pillars, roof rails, cross members, floor panels, etc.
• 3D modeling and 2D drawing creation using CAD software (Catia V5/V6, NX, etc.)
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (CAE, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and Quality) to meet product requirements.
• Support DFMEA, DVP, and validation plan preparation.
• Understand and incorporate crash, NVH, stiffness, and durability requirements in the design.
• Benchmarking and cost optimization for BIW parts.
• Tolerance stack-up analysis and GD&T implementation.
• Interact with suppliers for tooling feasibility and part manufacturability.
• Support prototype build, testing, and root cause analysis of issues

 Key Performance Indicators 
 • No Rework
• Timely delivery

 Role Requirement: 

 Educational Qualification​: BE / DME in Mechanical/production/automobile stream
 No. of years of work experience 
 If BE then 3- 6 years
 If DME then 5-7 years

 Critical Skill Sets (Technical) 
 • CAD Software:  Proficiency in CAD software such as CATIA, NX, for designing and modeling BIW components
• BIW Component Knowledge: Understanding of A/B/C pillars, roof rails, floor panels, cross members, etc
• Joining Technologies : Familiarity with spot welding, MIG welding, laser welding, adhesives, clinching, and riveting 
• GD&T:  Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) to ensure proper fit and function of components. 
• Manufacturing Processes:  Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as stamping, welding, and assembly techniques used in BIW production. 
• Drawing Creation : Preparation of detailed 2D drawings with BOM, annotations, and tolerances.

 Critical Skill Sets (Behavioral) 
 • Good communication skills
• Basic Problem Solving
• Continuous Improvement Orientation
• Ability to work in team
• Domestic / International Mobility readiness.

 Proficiency in languages 
 • English
• Hindi
• Regional / Native Language

 Awareness, Unity, Empowerment: 
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.

Regular / Permanent Group: 

Magna Steyr

jobs.title: Industrialization Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 Could you be the full-time Industrialization Engineer in Badli Depot (Delhi, India) we’re looking for?
 our future role 

 Take on a new challenge and apply your industrialization and maintenance expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside passionate and collaborative teammates.

 You'll play a key role in supporting industrial activities as part of the DMRC L2 Project, ensuring the implementation and optimization of preventive and overhaul maintenance activities. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (including Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Sourcing), support the design and maintenance of industrial equipment, and much more.

 You’ll specifically take care of assessing preventive and overhaul activities, as well as ensuring adherence to work instructions, but also support the creation of task lists, sequencing, and method execution.

 We’ll look to you for:

• 
 Assessing preventive and overhaul activities alongside DMRC/Alstom staff

• 
 Supporting the implementation of industrial work instructions

• 
 Identifying and addressing gaps between documented work instructions and actual activities

• 
 Verifying the list of parts for maintenance, including local technical information and supplier requirements

• 
 Providing input into the design of material handling equipment (MHE) and specific tooling equipment

• 
 Ensuring the maintenance of industrial equipment

• 
 Managing the maintenance and control of active tools on-site and at subcontractors

• 
 Supporting procurement activities such as e-buy creation, PR generation, and supplier follow-up

• 
 Maintaining traceability and audit documentation

• 
 Participating in inspections and self-checks

• 
 Implementing standard operating procedures and work instructions

 All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

• 
 Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering

• 
 Strong hands-on experience in preventive and overhaul maintenance processes

• 
 Experience with rolling stock maintenance (minimum 5 years)

• 
 Knowledge of GSI/SAP systems

• 
 Familiarity with CAD, 3D tools, SAP, and Maximo

• 
 Ability to read, write, and speak English fluently

• 
 Autonomous, rigorous, and equipped with strong communication skills

• 
 Innovative mindset and participative approach in business workgroups

 Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

• 
 Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines

• 
 Work with new security standards for rail signalling

• 
 Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

• 
 Contribute to innovative projects

• 
 Utilise our inclusive and flexible working environment

• 
 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

• 
 Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning

• 
 Progress towards roles such as Industrial Manager or other leadership positions

• 
 Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 Important to note 

 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

 Job Description: 

 The opportunity ​ 

As a Production Engineer at Hitachi, Ltd., you will play a crucial role in optimizing our manufacturing processes, ensuring efficient production, high-quality output, and continuous improvement across our facilities. You will be instrumental in the design, implementation, and maintenance of production systems to meet our operational goals.

 How you’ll make an impact 
 • Design, develop, and implement efficient and cost-effective manufacturing processes and production lines for new and existing products.
• Analyze production data, identify bottlenecks, and develop solutions to improve productivity, reduce waste, and enhance overall operational efficiency.
• Collaborate with R&D, design, and quality assurance teams to ensure manufacturability of new products and seamless transition from design to production.

• Evaluate and select appropriate manufacturing equipment and tools, and oversee their installation, calibration, and maintenance.

 Your background 

 • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering
• 3+ years of experience in a production or manufacturing engineering role, preferably within a large-scale manufacturing environment.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing principles, including Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) and other engineering tools.
• Experience with process optimization, root cause analysis, and problem-solving techniques.
• Knowledge of automation technologies, robotics, and advanced manufacturing systems is a plus.
• Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Familiarity with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) and industry-specific standards.
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and specifications.

jobs.title: Lead Process Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

 Could you be the full-time Lead Process Engineer in Bangalore we’re looking for?
 NY      Your future role 

 Take on a new challenge and apply your process engineering expertise in a cutting-edge field. You’ll work alongside a dedicated and innovative team of professionals.

 You'll play a pivotal role in driving industrial excellence and supporting the delivery of world-class mobility solutions. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (such as Product Development, Production, and Quality Assurance), define and deploy industrialization standards and methodologies, and much more.

 You’ll specifically take care of managing and developing your team’s skills and ensuring the successful industrialization of projects, but also support production activities and ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.

 We’ll look to you for:

• 
 Defining and updating function procedures, ways of working, and methodologies, aligned with central PME guidelines

• 
 Ensuring team staffing aligns with project workloads

• 
 Building induction and training programs for newcomers

• 
 Maintaining the team’s skills matrix and developing annual training plans

• 
 Deploying industrialization standards, methodologies, and IS tools (e.g., PLM, ERP, MES)

• 
 Increasing the maturity of the team using the APSYS roadmap

• 
 Supporting product/project industrialization activities and ensuring deliverables are accurate and of high quality

• 
 Ensuring adherence to EHS, ergonomics, and special process requirements

• 
 Providing production support, including for first articles manufacturing and onsite/offshore activities

 All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

• 
 Technical education background

• 
 Fluency in English (read, written, spoken)

• 
 8 to 10 years of experience, preferably in the railway, automobile, or aerospace industries

• 
 Technical expertise in process engineering, manufacturing work instructions, line balancing, Lean Manufacturing, and BOM creation

• 
 Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP) for Bill of Materials, routings, and configuration follow-up

• 
 Knowledge of CAD and PLM tools (e.g., CATIA, DELMIA)

• 
 Familiarity with quality standards, EHS, ergonomics, and process methodologies like Process FMEA, QRQC, and 8D

• 
 Strong leadership, team collaboration, and communication skills

• 
 A commitment to conscientiousness and delivering on promises

 Things you’ll enjoy Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

• 
 Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from repetitive routines

• 
 Work with new security standards for rail signalling

• 
 Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues

• 
 Contribute to innovative projects shaping the future of mobility

• 
 Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment

• 
 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

• 
 Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning opportunities

• 
 Progress towards senior leadership roles

• 
 Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

 Important to note 

 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

This role provides technical leadership on tooling strategy across programs, mentors junior engineers, and drives continuous improvement to meet safety, quality, cost, and schedule objectives.

• Deep knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, manufacturing processes (machining, fabrication, welding, composites), inspection techniques, and metrology.
• Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and working effectively with suppliers, production, quality, and design engineering.
• Strong analytical skills; experience with FEA for fixture analysis, tolerance stack-up software, and tooling validation methods.
• Demonstrated ability to deliver complex tooling projects on schedule and within budget.

• Experience in supplier management for large tooling builds and capability to lead vendor technical reviews and audits.
• Certification or training in Lean, Six Sigma, program management, or project leadership.
• Prior experience in a lead or principal engineer role driving tooling strategy across multiple programs.
• Strategic thinker with strong technical judgment and hands-on problem-solving orientation.
• Excellent verbal and written communication; effective presenting to leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
• Proven mentor and coach for engineering teams; fosters a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

jobs.desc:
About Us 

 At CNH, we're driven by a clear purpose: we serve and advance the people who feed and build a growing world. 

 As a global leader in agriculture and construction, we create the equipment, technology, and solutions that help our customers work more productively and sustainably. Our success starts with our people, and we foster a collaborative culture where innovation thrives and every employee has the opportunity to grow.

 Grow a Career. Build a Future. 

 If you're ready to make an impact and build a career with purpose, there's a place for you at CNH.

 Job Purpose 

 Construct, alter and repair a variety of special tools, templates, fixtures and weld jigs. They create customer success by delivering the best experiences to their internal and external customers.

 Key Responsibilities 

• Follow prescribed safety standards, rules and regulations including those regarding the usage of PPE, Emergency Plans and EH&S Policy.

• To identify unsafe acts and unsafe conditions by completing observation cards.

• To maintain 5s by removing all tools, equipment, and parts not needed in the work area and for those that are needed to ensure they have a dedicated, labeled home and are in that dedicated home. 

• To monitor for and alert their Team Leader or Supervisor of any abnormalities from the standards in their area. This includes abnormalities in standard processes, standard machine operation, product quality, and logistics management.

• Completes all CILR activities as required, identifies deficiencies and sources of contamination, including difficult access areas in the workstation, and provides suitable countermeasures to address these issues.

• Construct, alter and repair a variety of special tools and templates, fixtures, and weld jigs. 

• To fabricate parts to specifications using various manual fabrication machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Check tooling made or modified by outside subcontractors to insure it meets quality specifications.

• Bench work involving filing, grinding, assembling, and adjusting to obtain satisfactory operations.

• Perform welding requiring skill and knowledge of fabricating practices when the need arises.

• Responsible for cost reductions as applicable to the area. 

• Move materials as necessary in the performance of duties. 

• Ensure all products meet the quality guidelines and follow all quality standards, procedures and guidelines in place and be active in improving product quality.

• To be involved in the root cause analysis of S EWO, EWO, HERCA, and equipment problems.

• To contribute to the continuous improvement of safety, quality, and productivity by submitting one (1) Suggestion every two (2) months for a total of six (6) per year.

 Experience Required 

• Grade 12 diploma or equivalent.

• Minimum of two years’ experience working in manufacturing processes.

• Minimum of three years’ experience in welding and/or in the fabrication of parts using machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Ability to read and understand blueprints, including welding diagrams and symbols.

• Ability to work with minimal supervision.

• Good verbal, and written communication skills.

• Experience in trouble shooting and problem solving.

• Able to perform considerable physical effort consisting of frequently lifting or moving average weight material in difficult work positions. The candidate must be physically able to wear a respirator while some tasks such as light painting.

 Preferred Qualifications 

• Proficiency in both MIG welding and operation of manual fabrication machines such as saws, brakes, lathes, and mills.

• Journeyperson certification in a related field. 

 Pay Transparency 

 The annual salary for this role is CAD $35.84 - $39.90 plus any applicable bonus (Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as skill, experience and qualification for the role.)

 For roles open across multiple locations, the salary range indicated refers to the primary location. If a different location is considered, the applicable salary range will be communicated to candidates prior to the first interview. 

 What We Offer 

 We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

 At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:

• Savings & Retirement benefits 

• Tuition reimbursement 

• Parental leave 

• Employee Assistance Programs  

 Click here to learn more about our benefits offerings! (US only)

Applicants can learn more about their rights by viewing the federal "Know Your Rights" poster here . CNH Industrial participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. You can view additional information here . 

 Canada applicants: CNH Industrial is an equal opportunity employer. This company considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, place of origin, disability, marital status, family status, age, or any other ground prohibited by applicable provincial human rights legislation. 

 If you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at narecruitingmailbox@cnh.com .

This role develops tooling for assembly, forming, drilling, and machining processes and collaborates with multiple disciplines to solve problems, implement corrective actions, and support continuous improvement.

 • Design tools for assembly, forming, drilling, and machining processes, considering safety, ergonomics, quality, and productivity requirements.
• Apply Tool Design Manuals and best shop practices to tooling design activities.
• Consider material properties to ensure tools meet applicable safety and performance standards.
• Apply manufacturing process knowledge involving mechanical assembly, sheet metal, CNC machining, welding, and composite fabrication.
• Participate in RCCA activities to resolve internal and external quality problems and support corrective actions.
• Support operations and manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with engineering and quality standards.
• Analyze, conceptualize, and execute continuous improvement activities to optimize tooling designs and processes.
• Collaborate with other disciplines and teams across the business.
• Use MS Office for engineering documentation and support activities.
• Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, at an advanced level.
 Qualifications You Must Have
 • A bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or related field and minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience.
• Experience designing tools in the aerospace industry.
• Experience using CAD software for detailed tooling design, including CATIA V5 Part Design, Product Design, and Generative Shape Design.
• Experience interpreting engineering models and drawings.
• Experience applying GD&T to the dimensioning and tolerancing of tooling components.
 Qualifications We Prefer
 • Experience with NC programming, cutting tools, setups, and machine accessories.
• Experience interpreting welding nomenclature.
• Experience with standard hardware and components used in tooling design.

 Monitoring and reporting on mechanical activity progress, addressing potential issues

 Providing technical support to production teams and customers

 Ensuring supplier and sub-contractor design quality

• 
 BS Degree in Mechanical Engineering

 5+ years of experience in Mechanical Design Engineering or 2+ years in railway or railcar products (e.g., locomotives, rail passenger cars)

 Knowledge of metallic materials (physical properties and design) and industrial processes (welding, bending, machining)

 Familiarity with welding codes such as AWS

 Experience with Catia v5 (minimum 3+ years full-time or 5,000 hours)

 Preferred experience with PDM/PLM tools (e.g., Enovia-DMA, 3DCom)

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including teamwork

 Work with new security standards for rail signalling

 Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues

 Utilise our collaborative and forward-thinking working environment

 Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries

• Support customer discussions to finalize product designs, technical specifications, and manufacturing requirements while meeting quality, cost, delivery, and productivity targets.
• Maintain and improve CAD data management systems for products, tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing equipment.
• Capture, document, and share best practices and lessons learned across global casting operations.

• Strong problem-solving, analytical, and root-cause investigation skills.

The Boeing Company 

 Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA) is currently seeking a Tool and Fixture Specialist  to join the Propulsion South Carolina(PSC) Tool Construction team   in Ladson , South Carolina  on second shift .  

 Propulsion South Carolina (PSC) is seeking an experienced Tool & Fixture Specialist to support second shift operations. Primary responsibilities are performing emergent repair of broken tooling and periodic maintenance of tooling used to assemble 737 inlets and build up 787 engines. The PSC tool construction shop has a variety of manual and computer-controlled mills, lathes, and other machines used to fabricate replacement tooling details. • Adhesion and overmold bonding requirements

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. You’ll report to NGHST Project Engineering Manager, and work alongside exceptional, enthusiastic and collaborative teammates. You'll be creating great value as you use your engineering skills to maximize engineering development of component repairability and testability for next generation high speed rail transportation projects.  All about you 

 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:  

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field (or equivalent) with strong electrical background 

• Familiar with component design and redesign, obsolescence, and risk management across a broad set of systems 

• Strong knowledge of electrical systems, ideally including PCB design/exposure (mandatory) 

• Minimum 3 years’ experience in engineering related field - system engineering.  

• 
 Experience in at least one of the following specialized areas within rail, transportation, or related heavy industry: hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, electronics/electrical hardware, railway door systems, railway signaling systems, railway HVAC, or railway mechanical systems. 

• Experience working ‘hands on’ with railway equipment (ideally in the environment of Rolling Stock warranty and reliability growth) is desired.  

• Knowledge of railway systems is desired. 

• Utilize your skills in strategic system thinking 

• 
 Leadership or team lead experience, with the ability to mentor and build a team 

• Self-starter who can independently own projects with minimal day-to-day oversight 

 Things you’ll enjoy 

 Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also: 

• Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career free from boring daily routines. 

• Work with cutting edge systems in high speed rail. 

• Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues. 

• Contribute to innovative projects. 

• Utilise our collaborative working environment. 

• Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries. 

• Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning. 

• Progress towards engineering leadership roles. 

• Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward packag e that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, 401k). 

 Location and Travel 

• On-site position based in New Castle, DE (Alstom East Coast Distribution Facility), some remote work flexibility. 

• Average travel: up to 20% of time. 

 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

 Knorr Brake Company is the innovative leader in the manufacture and supply of braking systems, passenger doors and climate-control equipment for all types of Mass Transit customers such as: METRO, Light Rail Vehicles, High-Speed Trains, Commuter Rail and Monorail Vehicles for the North America market. We’re part of the Knorr-Bremse Group, the global leader in braking technologies. We challenge our employees to pursue their work with passion while keeping an unparalleled commitment to technological excellence, integrity and social responsibility.

Knorr-Brake Company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer.  JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 The Manufacturing Engineer’s role, working under the direction of the Production Manager is to ensure all that all production activity within Merak is performed safely and efficiently by providing the necessary tooling, technology and traceable processes to support Merak profitability and sustained growth.  

 Essential Functions 

• Designs and implements effective and efficient tooling and devices with emphasis on safety and reliability. 

• Provides and maintains operation instructions for equipment and processes via the SAP routing module or TWI’s

• Evaluates and improves manufacturing processes by designing and conducting research programs; applying knowledge of product design, fabrication, assembly, tooling, and materials; conferring with equipment vendors

• Researching, designing, modifying, and testing manufacturing methods and equipment; conferring with equipment vendors

• Provides manufacturing decision-making information by calculating production, labor, and material costs; reviewing production schedules; estimating future requirements

• Prepares product and process reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends

• Provides manufacturing engineering information by answering questions and requests

• Completes design and development projects by training and guiding technicians

• Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; participating in professional societies

• Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

• Develops, investigates and implements cost reduction efforts and related activities to reduce product and operating cost.  Recommend material and product design modifications for the purpose of reducing cost or improving quality.

• Fosters safety and efficiency via lean manufacturing principles

• Must be able to follow instructions, safety & environmental rules and regulations. Documents, implements and manages capital expense endeavors.

• Engage in special projects related to new contract demands

• Act as Team Lead for ME Department

 Knowledge: 

• new project analysis

• Technical work instructions

• line balancing

• time studies

 Skills

• Production environment

• Complex assemblies

• Processes with multiple steps

• CAD modeling

• 3d printing

• CNC experience is a plus

 Experience: 

• Three to five years of experience in a similar position and industrial environment.

• Knowledge in complex assemblies is a plus

 Education: 

• Bachelor´s degree in engineering

ALTEN is a global engineering and technology consultancy operating across over 35 countries worldwide. We partner with industry leaders across sectors including Aeronautics, Aerospace, Defence, Naval, Automotive, Energy, Rail, IT and many more to deliver innovative engineering solutions that drive technological advancement & support sustainable transformation.
 Our teams of passionate and agile engineers work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of technology and sustainability. At ALTEN, we empower talented engineers to innovate, solve complex challenges, and deliver impactful solutions that build tomorrow’s world—today.
 Join us and start building tomorrow’s world today!

 We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Industrialisation Engineer to support the successful transition of product designs into manufacturing. This position requires a strong understanding of design validation, manufacturing feasibility, and industrialisation processes, working closely with design teams to ensure products can be manufactured efficiently and to the required quality standards.
 • Location: Broughton 
• On Site: Fully Onsite  
• Clearance: Clearable  
• Experience Level: Mid Level 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Support industrialisation activities by validating designs for manufacturability and assembly.
• Investigate and resolve manufacturing and assembly abnormalities, including: • One-way assembly breakdowns
• Rib clashes
• Design and assembly-related issues

• Collaborate closely with design engineering teams to ensure designs are feasible from an industrial and manufacturing perspective.
• Review and interpret engineering drawings, GD&T requirements, notes, tolerances, and manufacturing specifications.
• Participate in and contribute to Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) activities.
• Support Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Assess tooling requirements and support redesign activities where necessary.
• Drive Design for Manufacture (DFM) improvements to optimise production efficiency, quality, and cost.
• Provide manufacturing process expertise during product development and industrialisation phases.

 Required Skills: 
 • Experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrialisation Engineering, Production Engineering, or a similar discipline.
• Strong working knowledge of: • DFMEA
• PFMEA
• Design for Manufacture (DFM)
• Engineering drawings and geometric tolerancing
• Manufacturing validation activities

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, notes, dimensions, and tolerances.
• Good understanding of common manufacturing processes, including: • Drilling
• Reaming
• Spot facing
• Machining and assembly processes

• Experience working collaboratively with design offices and engineering teams.
• Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Mandatory Aerospace experience is needed  
 Required Qualifications: 
 • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering , or  equivalent   military experience .
 Desirable Skills: 
 • Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) or industrialisation projects.
• Knowledge of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies.

 Why join us?  
 We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies.
 At ALTEN, you’ll work on exciting projects, supported by ongoing learning, mentoring, and clear career development tailored to your goals.
 Join a passionate team and help build tomorrow, today.
 In short you get:  
 • A personalised career path and a rewarding management style 
• A huge diversity of engineering projects and industries
• Private Medical Insurance
• Cycle & Tech Scheme 
• Employee assistance programme
• Life insurance & Pension Scheme
• Social atmosphere, regular gatherings & team buildings
• Flexible way of working (role dependent)

We recognise the value of military skills and experience and are committed to ensuring that no applicant is unfairly disadvantaged during our recruitment and selection processes.  
 ALTEN is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and values the strength that comes from a global mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of background or protected characteristics under the Equality Act 2010. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

ALTEN is a global engineering and technology consultancy operating across over 35 countries worldwide. We partner with industry leaders across sectors including Aeronautics, Aerospace, Defence, Naval, Automotive, Energy, Rail, IT and many more to deliver innovative engineering solutions that drive technological advancement & support sustainable transformation.
 Our teams of passionate and agile engineers work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of technology and sustainability. At ALTEN, we empower talented engineers to innovate, solve complex challenges, and deliver impactful solutions that build tomorrow’s world—today.
 Join us and start building tomorrow’s world today!

 ALTEN is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team, supporting an exciting and technically challenging engineering programme.
 This opportunity would suit a Mechanical Design Engineer with strong Siemens NX experience who is confident developing detailed 3D designs and engineering drawings within a complex engineering environment.
 • Location: Bicester  
• On Site: Onsite  
• Clearance: Clearable 
• Experience Level: Mid Level 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Develop and modify 3D mechanical designs using Siemens NX 
• Produce accurate 2D engineering drawings to support manufacture and assembly
• Design mechanical components and assemblies in line with engineering requirements
• Work closely with engineering, manufacturing and technical teams throughout the design lifecycle
• Review existing designs and implement engineering modifications where required
• Ensure designs meet relevant quality, manufacturing and technical standards 
• Support design reviews and resolve technical issues during development

 Required Skills: 
 • 3+ years’ experience within Mechanical Design, CAD Engineering or a similar role
• Experience within the Aerospace Industry
• Strong hands-on experience with Siemens NX – mandatory 
• Experience creating detailed 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings 
• Good understanding of mechanical engineering and design principles
• Experience working with mechanical components and assemblies
• Ability to interpret technical specifications and engineering requirements
 Required Qualifications: 
 • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering , or  equivalent   military experience .
 Desirable Skills: 
 • Experience within a highly regulated or complex engineering environment 
• Knowledge of GD&T and engineering tolerancing 
• Understanding of manufacturing processes and design for manufacture 
• Experience supporting designs from concept through to production

 Why join us?  
 We bring together entrepreneurial, tech-driven people to deliver innovative solutions for leading companies.
 At ALTEN, you’ll work on exciting projects, supported by ongoing learning, mentoring, and clear career development tailored to your goals.
 Join a passionate team and help build tomorrow, today.
 In short you get:  
 • A personalised career path and a rewarding management style 
• A huge diversity of engineering projects and industries
• Private Medical Insurance
• Cycle & Tech Scheme 
• Employee assistance programme
• Life insurance & Pension Scheme
• Social atmosphere, regular gatherings & team buildings
• Flexible way of working (role dependent)
 We are proud to support the Armed Forces Covenant & actively encourage applications from members of the Armed Forces community, including veterans, reservists, service leavers, and military spouses/partners. We recognise the value of military skills and experience and are committed to ensuring that no applicant is unfairly disadvantaged during our recruitment and selection processes.  
 ALTEN is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and values the strength that comes from a global mix of backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of background or protected characteristics under the Equality Act 2010. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.  
 This role may require you to have or be willing to go through Security Clearance. As part of the onboarding process candidates will be asked to complete a Baseline Personnel Security Standard; details of the evidence required to apply may be found on the government website Gov.UK. If you are unable to meet this and any associated criteria, then your employment may be delayed, or rejected . Details of this will be discussed with you at interview.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer – Rotating Equipment
jobs.desc:
ALTEN is a global engineering and technology consultancy operating across over 35 countries worldwide. We partner with industry leaders across sectors including Aeronautics, Aerospace, Defence, Naval, Automotive, Energy, Rail, IT and many more to deliver innovative engineering solutions that drive technological advancement & support sustainable transformation.
 Our teams of passionate and agile engineers work on cutting-edge projects that shape the future of technology and sustainability. At ALTEN, we empower talented engineers to innovate, solve complex challenges, and deliver impactful solutions that build tomorrow’s world—today.
 Join us and start building tomorrow’s world today!

 ALTEN is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join an exciting aerospace engineering programme focused on the design and development of high-precision rotating mechanical systems and components .
 • Location: Luton 
• On Site: 3x onsite 
• Clearance: Clearable  
• Experience Level: Mid Level 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design and develop high-precision mechanical components and assemblies for aerospace applications.
• Create detailed 3D models and assemblies using CATIA V5 .
• Produce and review comprehensive 2D manufacturing drawings .
• Apply GD&T principles to define functional requirements and ensure components can be manufactured and inspected correctly.
• Define appropriate dimensional and geometric tolerances for high-precision components , including micrometre-level requirements where applicable.
• Design mechanical components used within rotating equipment and power transmission systems .
• Select suitable engineering materials, particularly steel and aluminium alloys , considering strength, weight, durability, operating conditions and manufacturability.
• Select appropriate manufacturing processes based on material, geometry, tolerance, surface finish and performance requirements.
• Consider manufacturing capability throughout the design process to deliver robust and manufacturable engineering solutions.
• Perform engineering assessments including tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups where required.
• Support component and assembly design reviews throughout the product development lifecycle.
• Work closely with Stress, Materials, Manufacturing, Quality and Systems Engineering teams .
• Support manufacturing teams with the resolution of design and production-related technical issues.
• Review engineering drawings, design specifications and technical documentation.
• Support engineering changes, design modifications and product improvements.
• Ensure designs meet applicable aerospace quality, safety and engineering requirements .

 Required Skills: 
 • Previous professional experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer within aerospace or another high-precision engineering environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with CATIA V5 .
• Proven experience in 3D part modelling and assembly design .
• Strong experience producing 2D detailed manufacturing drawings .
• Good practical knowledge of GD&T / geometric tolerancing .
• Experience designing components requiring tight dimensional and geometric tolerances .
• Good knowledge of metallic engineering materials, particularly steel and aluminium .
• Understanding of material selection and how material properties influence mechanical design.
• Good knowledge of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacture .
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications and manufacturing requirements.
• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 Required Qualifications: 
 • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering , or  equivalent   military experience .
 Desirable Skills: 
 • Previous experience within the aerospace industry .
• Mechanical design experience with gearboxes, electric motors, generators or rotating machinery .
• Experience designing shafts, bearings, gears or precision rotating components .
• Knowledge of tolerance stack-ups and high-precision mechanical design .
• Understanding of machining, heat treatment and surface finishing processes .
• Experience working within a safety-critical or highly regulated engineering environment .

jobs.title: Advanced Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
ABOUT APTIV 

 At Aptiv, we are shaping the future of mobility by developing technologies that make transportation safer, greener, and more connected. Our teams collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, and product development to deliver innovative solutions for the world’s leading automotive manufacturers.

 The North American Connection Systems team is at the forefront of developing advanced manufacturing technologies and processes that transform product concepts into scalable, high-quality production solutions. If you are passionate about hands-on engineering, innovation, and solving complex manufacturing challenges, we invite you to join us.

 YOUR ROLE 

 We are seeking an Advanced Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at the Champion Technical Center in Warren, Ohio .

 In this role, you will work closely with Product Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, and Supplier partners to develop and industrialize new products from prototype through full-scale production. You will play a key role in designing manufacturing processes, developing tooling and fixturing, and introducing innovative technologies that improve product quality, efficiency, and scalability.
 This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys a hands-on environment, thrives on problem solving, and is passionate about bringing new products and manufacturing technologies to life.

 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE 

 You will partner with cross-functional teams across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to develop robust manufacturing solutions that support both new product launches and continuous improvement initiatives.

 In your daily work, you will: 

 • Develop manufacturing processes for new products from prototype through serial production.

• Design, develop, and implement tooling and fixturing solutions to support product development and manufacturing activities.

• Lead advanced manufacturing projects focused on improving existing processes, equipment, and production methods.

• Identify and incorporate leading-edge manufacturing technologies into Aptiv products and operations.

• Create and maintain work instructions, process documentation, lessons learned, and project status updates.

• Develop manufacturing process estimates and contribute to Statements of Work (SOWs) for product industrialization activities.

• Collaborate with engineering teams, manufacturing plants, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution.

• Drive supplier activities, technical requirements, and project timelines to support launch objectives.

• Utilize data-driven analysis to support engineering decisions and process improvements.

• Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements, internal quality standards, and manufacturing best practices.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety, quality, efficiency, and cost optimization.

 KEY SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 

 To be successful in this role, you should bring: 

 • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.

• 1-2 years of experience building, improving, repairing, or developing manufacturing equipment, fixtures, or processes.

• 1-2 years of experience working within a manufacturing environment and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.

• Ability to visualize manufacturing processes and understand component interactions.

• Experience using CAD software such as SolidWorks, Solid Edge, AutoCAD, NX, or similar design tools.

• Ability to translate ideas into technical concepts, CAD models, prototypes, and production-ready solutions.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and project execution skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization.

• Self-motivated, adaptable, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced environment.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: 

 • CAM software such as Mastercam, Trumpf TruTops, or similar platforms.

• Automated manufacturing equipment design and implementation.

• Ultrasonic welding technologies.

• Laser cutting and laser welding processes.

• Electrical connector component design or assembly processes.

• Design for Manufacturing (DFM) methodologies.

• Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).

• Advanced manufacturing automation and industrialization projects.

• Microsoft Office applications including Excel, Project, Outlook, Word, and Teams.

 WORK ENVIRONMENT 

 • Full-time on-site role based at the Champion Technical Center in Warren, Ohio.

• Combination of office, laboratory, manufacturing facility, and supplier/customer interaction.

• Up to 10% travel may be required to support manufacturing plants, supplier assessments, technology evaluations, and project activities.

• Hands-on involvement in prototype development, testing, tooling validation, and production support activities.

 WHY JOIN APTIV? 

 • Work on innovative technologies that shape the future of mobility.

• Collaborate with industry-leading engineers and manufacturing experts.

• Gain hands-on experience developing cutting-edge manufacturing solutions.

• Opportunities for career growth, technical development, and leadership advancement.

• Inclusive and collaborative work environment focused on innovation and continuous learning.

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

 APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICE 

 Your privacy is important to us. Aptiv complies with all applicable data privacy laws and regulations throughout the recruitment process.
 Aptiv is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees can contribute and succeed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing equal employment opportun

 What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

 Group Summary: 
 Cosma provides a comprehensive range of body, chassis and engineering solutions to global customers. Through our robust product engineering, outstanding tooling capabilities and diverse process expertise, we continue to bring lightweight and innovative products to market.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled and motivated Manufacturing Engineer with CNC machining experience to support our manufacturing operations and drive continuous improvement initiatives. This position is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing CNC machining processes to improve productivity, quality, safety, and cost performance. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in CNC machining, process development, tooling, fixture design, and lean manufacturing principles.
 Essential Responsibilities 
 · Develop, implement, and optimize CNC machining processes for new and existing products.
 · Evaluate and improve manufacturing methods, work instructions, tooling, fixtures, and equipment to maximize efficiency and quality.
 · Support new product launches through process development, equipment validation, and production readiness activities.
 · Analyze machining operations to reduce cycle times, improve throughput, and minimize scrap and rework.
 · Collaborate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Supply Chain teams to resolve manufacturing issues and improve performance.
 · Lead root cause analysis and corrective action activities utilizing tools such as 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagrams, and PFMEA.
 · Develop and maintain process documentation, including standard operating procedures, process flow diagrams, control plans, and work instructions.
 · Support CNC programming improvements and collaborate with programmers and operators to optimize machining performance.
 · Identify and implement automation, error-proofing, and continuous improvement opportunities.
 · Participate in capital equipment projects, including equipment selection, installation, startup, validation, and process acceptance.
 · Monitor and analyze production metrics to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), quality, and cost performance.
 · Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
 · Provide technical training and support to production personnel as needed.
 Required Qualifications 
 · Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field.
 · Minimum of 3 years of manufacturing engineering experience in a CNC machining environment.
 · Strong knowledge of CNC machining processes, including milling, turning, drilling, and multi-axis machining.
 · Experience with cutting tools, tooling selection, fixturing, and process optimization.
 · Understanding of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and engineering drawings.
 · Experience with root cause analysis and continuous improvement methodologies.
 · Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
 · Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
 · Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 · 5+ years of CNC manufacturing engineering experience in a high-volume manufacturing environment.
 · Experience with CAD/CAM software such as Mastercam, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, NX, or Creo.
 · Familiarity with Fanuc, Haas, Mazak, Okuma, or similar CNC controls.
 · Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies.
 · Experience with APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, and SPC.
 · Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
 · Experience with automation, robotics, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
 · Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or IATF 16949 quality systems.
 Physical Requirements 
 · Ability to work in a manufacturing environment around machining equipment and moving machinery.
 · Ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
 · Ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
 · Ability to travel occasionally as needed.
 Work Authorization 
 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization under a TN or H-1B visa may be considered, provided they are authorized to work for this employer without requiring new or additional visa sponsorship. The company is unable to sponsor new employment-based visas or provide other immigration sponsorship for this position.

 Cosma provides a comprehensive range of body, chassis and engineering solutions to global customers. Through our robust product engineering, outstanding tooling capabilities and diverse process expertise, we continue to bring lightweight and innovative products to market.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 • Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes that enable the safe, efficient, and cost-effective production of quality parts. Support production performance through data analysis, KPI monitoring, process optimization, and problem-solving activities to improve quality, productivity, and operational results.

 • College Diploma or University Degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
• 1–2 years of engineering experience in an automotive or manufacturing environment (including co-op or internship experience).
• Proficiency with CAD software for product design and plant layouts (e.g., AutoCAD, NX, CATIA, or SolidWorks).

Success in this role requires strong machining knowledge, experience with Mastercam, SolidWorks, and machine controls such as Fanuc or Siemens, along with the ability to manage multiple projects, communicate clearly, and actively support a safe manufacturing environment.

 Key Job Responsibilities 

• Provides technical assistance to Manufacturing Engineering and Manufacturing organization. 

• Analyzes drawings, sketches, and design data of part to determine dimension and configuration of cuts. Creates and maintains programs which includes selecting fixturing and cutting tools, and machine speeds and feeds; and creates process sheets and tooling lists for Boring Bar and Horizontal Machining Centers.

 Qualifications/Requirements

• Familiar with a variety of field concepts, practices, and procedures. 

• Relies on extensive experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals. 

• Familiar with large equipment and parts 

• Language Ability: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write necessary correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization. 

 Safety

• Promote and support a safety-first culture by designing, improving, and sustaining manufacturing processes that protect employees, reduce risk, and support safe work execution.

• Incorporate Komatsu safety goals, policies, and cardinal safety expectations into engineering decisions, process improvements, equipment layouts, tooling changes, and standard work.

• Partner with operations, safety, quality, maintenance, and production teams to identify hazards, assess risk, and implement corrective actions that improve employee safety and operational performance.

• Actively support continuous improvement initiatives that reduce unsafe conditions, improve ergonomics, eliminate waste, and strengthen reliable day-to-day work practices.

 Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

 The Manufacturing Engineer for the Value Innovation Group will lead cross functional cost reduction and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.  The ideal candidate will have practical and demonstrated knowledge of fabrication, welding, painting, and assembly processes, along with experience developing manufacturing methods that consistently produce parts to print specifications.     

 The Manufacturing Engineer will use manufacturing knowledge, data analysis, value engineering, process improvement, and project management methods to develop financially supported recommendations and move approved projects from concept through implementation.

jobs.desc:
À la tête des entreprises qui s’engagent vers un avenir plus vert, Alstom développe et commercialise des solutions de mobilité qui apportent les fondements durables pour l'avenir des transports. Notre portefeuille de produits s'étend des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways jusqu’aux systèmes intégrés, services sur mesure, infrastructures, signalisation et solutions de mobilité numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est rejoindre une entreprise bienveillante, responsable et innovante où plus de 80 000 personnes ouvrent la voie à une mobilité plus verte et plus intelligente, dans le monde entier. Évoluer au sein d’Alstom permet de développer ses compétences, la reconnaissance et d’évoluer dans un contexte international. Nous sommes leader mondial du transport et de la mobilité durable, nous construisons la mobilité de demain. 

 Notre site de Bourgogne (850 salariés), Alstom Le Creusot, est centre d'excellence en matière de conception et fabrication de bogies (châssis, roues, essieux, freins) pour les TGV, trams, trains, métros en France et dans le monde. Le site est situé en plein cœur de Bourgogne, à 1h20 de Paris et 40 min de Lyon (TGV). 

 Nous recrutons un/une Stagiaire (4 à 5 mois) - Ingénieur suspension bogie - F/H (Bac+ 4 ou 5) 

 Votre futur rôle 

 Vous mettrez à profit vos compétences en en mécanique au sein d'un environnement industriel de pointe. Vous travaillerez avec une équipe experte, collaborative et dynamique, et jouerez un rôle dans l’amélioration de nos process de développement. Vous vous occuperez plus particulièrement de la conception d’un outil de calcul des suspensions de bogie dont l'architecture est de type "boite à bras" ainsi que la conception de procédures et rapports d'essai template à usage des fournisseurs. 

 Au quotidien, vous serez amené à:  

• Définir les besoins avec les parties prenantes pour apporter toutes les améliorations necessaires, 

• Concevoir l'outil de calcul avec tuto et guidelines en automatisant le plus possible les recherches de solutions, 

• Concevoir des fichiers template pour les procedures et les rapports d'essai en fonction des type de composants, 

• Collaborer avec les équipes pour intégrer vos solutions dans les processus existants, 

• Apprendre et appliquer les notions de Railway Dynamique et de composants suspensions bogies, 

• Participer à la vie de l'équipe de développement des composants. 

 Votre profil 

 Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année de cycle ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en mécanique. 

 Vous possédez idéalement : 

• des connaissances de base en mécanique et en langage VBA, 

• une appétence pour l’apprentissage de nouvelles notions techniques, notamment dans le domaine des suspensions bogies et des pièces caoutchouc-métal, 

• des aptitudes à s’exprimer en anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, 

• une certaine curiosité, une rigueur et êtes doté d’un bon esprit d’analyse, 

• une motivation pour le travail en équipe tout en étant autonome dans la gestion de vos missions. 

 Chez Alstom, nous accordons plus d'importance à la passion et à l’état d’esprit qu'à l'expérience. C'est pourquoi nous n'attendons pas de vous que vous maitrisez toutes ces compétences mais que vous ayez l'envie de les développer. 

 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

 Nous valorisons le leadership, la résilience, l’adaptabilité et un état d’esprit d’apprentissage continu. En tant que stagiaire, vous aurez l’opportunité de développer votre expertise dans un environnement stimulant et de contribuer à des projets ayant un impact direct sur nos performances industrielles. 

 Ce que vous apprécierez 

 Nous vous permettrons de vivre une expérience professionnelle au sein d'un secteur d'avenir où vous développerez de nouvelles compétences et expériences qui seront ensuite utiles tout au long de votre carrière. 

 Vous pourrez également :

• Contribuer à des projets innovants, 

• Evoluer au sein d'un groupe à renommée mondiale, 

• Participer à la construction des solutions de mobilité durable de demain. 

 Il n'est pas nécessaire d'être un passionné de trains pour s'épanouir chez nous. Nous vous garantissons que lorsque vous monterez dans l'un de nos trains avec vos amis ou votre famille, vous en serez fier. Si vous êtes prêt à relever le défi, nous aimerions vous connaître ! Postulez dès maintenant et devenez acteur/trice de la transformation industrielle chez Alstom ! 

 Alstom garantit l'égalité des chances et s'engage en tant qu’employeur à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où tous sont encouragés à atteindre leur plein potentiel, et où les différences individuelles sont valorisées et respectées. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions and value-added services for freight and transit rail. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation and Faiveley Transport, the company has unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress, creating transportation solutions that move and improve the world. Wabtec has approximately 30,000 employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit the company’s new website at: http://www.WabtecCorp.com .

It’s not just about your career… or your job title…it’s about who you are and the impact you are going to make on the world. Do you want to go into uncharted waters…do things that haven’t been done to make your and someone else's life better? Wabtec has been doing that for decades and we will continue to do so! Through our people, leadership development, services, technology, and scale, Wabtec delivers better outcomes for global customers by speaking the language of industry.
 Who will you be working with? 
 You will be working with our Methods team to provide quality services to design and implement manufacturing processes that guarantee safety, quality, customer satisfaction and competitiveness. You will interact daily with the line leader, manpower and quality engineers.
 How will you make a difference? 
 As a member of the manufacturing engineering team at Wabtec Passenger Transit, you will be responsible for:
 • Develop, implement, and document robust and cost-effective manufacturing processes, work instructions, and methods in accordance with product specifications, safety and quality standards, and customer demand.
• Lead the design of required tooling and accessories.
• Evaluate design and engineering changes, determine production feasibility, and approve release to manufacturing.
• Recommend and implement improvements in production processes, methods, and controls, using the principles of lean manufacturing.
• Process Monitoring & Analysis 

Regularly inspect production lines, equipment, and workflows to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, or quality issues. Use data from production logs, sensors, and operator reports to track performance metrics.
• Quality Assurance 

Work in partnership with Quality Assurance to check first time test results, scrap rates, and defect trends; recommend and/or lead corrective actions or process changes to improve product quality
• Equipment & Tooling Support 

Assist in troubleshooting equipment malfunctions, coordinate and support maintenance schedules, and review tooling designs for wear or inefficiency; may recommend replacements or redesigns
• Documentation & Reporting 

Update and maintain manufacturing process documents (Work Instructions, PFMEA, control plans, flowcharts) and prepare reports for management on production performance, costs, and improvements
• Lean & Continuous Improvement 

Apply lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Kaizen principles to identify waste, reduce cycle times, and improve safety
• Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Work with design, quality, and operations teams to ensure product designs are manufacturable and to resolve production issues quickly
• Training & Mentoring 

Conduct on-the-job or classroom training for operators and technicians on new processes, safety procedures, or efficiency techniques
• Compliance & Safety Checks 

Ensure all manufacturing activities follow safety regulations, environmental standards, and company policies
• Cost & Resource Analysis 

Review labor, material, and equipment costs; suggest changes to reduce waste and improve cost efficiency
• Project Support 

Assist in new product launches by setting up production processes, validating tooling, and training teams on new methods
 What do we want to know about you? 
 • Bachelor of Engineering Technology in Mechanical, Electrical or Industrial Engineering or related engineering.
• Five or more years of manufacturing experience preferred.
• Demonstrated mechanical aptitude is preferred.
• Strong lean manufacturing skills.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire others.
• Strong problem-solving and customer service skills.
• Possibility of traveling, when necessary, minimal.
 What will your typical day look like? 
 • Start the day by planning your scheduled meetings, projects and assigned tasks.
• Review internal communication [email, teams] and respond or resolve.
• Early in the morning, meet with the operations leader and the quality engineer to review daily performance, new issues or problems to be resolved and communicate the progress of pending activities.
• Attend and participate in the daily production meeting.
• Dedicate planned time to ensure your projects move forward and complete assigned tasks.
• Dedicate a large part of your time to walking, observing and supporting your processes.
• If necessary, use the company's different systems and applications to document the process, resolve problems or develop improvements.
• Arrive on time for your meetings and you will participate proactively, professionally and purposefully.
• Spend time reviewing the key performance indicators of your processes to identify trends, risks or opportunities.
• Send progress reports on your tasks and projects.
• You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary.

 The employee will normally work in a temperature-controlled office environment, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.

 Rattaché(e) à la Direction des Méthodes Industrielles, vous interviendrez en tant qu’expert(e) sur des missions de retouche de pièces, de création de gammes de fabrication, et de gestion des ordres de fabrication (OF) . Vos missions seront les suivantes :
 • Modifier et créer des gammes de fabrication adaptées aux processus industriels (DVI)
• Modifier, créer et assurer le suivi des ordres de fabrication (OF)
• Analyser les RNC (Retours Non-Conformités) et proposer des solutions correctives
• Modifier des plans d’ébauche dans CATIA V5 et les exporter dans le logiciel PLM (SMARTEAM)
