jobs.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Lead Manufacturing Engineer – Coatings Manufacturing Readiness supports the design, sourcing, and production of complex aerospace components and assemblies for Edison Works Advanced Programs. In this role, you will drive design for manufacturing readiness, producibility, reduce manufacturing cost and risk, and ensure our suppliers along with internal GE shops can deliver safely, on quality, on time, and at cost — with a specific focus on coatings and surface engineering technologies.The job allows modification of procedures and practices covering work as long as the end results meet standards of acceptability (quality, volume, timeliness etc.). 

 Job Description 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 • Leverages expertise in one or more coatings and surface engineering areas, such as thermal spray (HVOF, plasma, cold spray), electron beam physical vapor deposition (EB-PVD), diffusion/aluminide coatings, slurry and sol-gel coatings, thermal barrier coatings (TBCs), environmental barrier coatings (EBCs), plating, and other surface treatments.
• Develops coating process methods, masking/tooling and fixtures, programming, and production coating operations. Applies surface engineering techniques that improve hardware producibility and durability at the design phase and process development at the production phase.
• Leads efforts with Design Engineering to implement "Design for Producibility" for coated components, fabrications, tooling, and assemblies. This includes assessing coatability/producibility, evaluating drawings and coating callouts, contributing to MRL projects for new coating hardware/technologies, creating/reviewing coating process schedules and routers, estimating should-costs, estimating lead times, and developing quality plans.
• Assists Edison Works Supply Chain in program reviews to ensure coatings and surface treatment manufacturing considerations are addressed.
• Works closely with Supply Chain functions on hardware production in shops and suppliers – from issuing purchase orders to milestone planning to hardware delivery. Assesses quality, delivery, and cost risks early (including coating adhesion, thickness, and metallurgical quality risks) and provides support on problem solving to attain rate.
• Manages integrated schedules, aligns cross-functional teams, and ensures on-time, at-cost execution of commitments.
• Acts as a key interface with DoD customers, managing contractual obligations and fostering clear communication across stakeholders.
• Possesses in-depth knowledge of coatings best practices and integrates with others; maintains working knowledge of industry coating capability to help make decisions on process and supplier.
• Adopts FLIGHT DECK actively in all aspects of work scopes, using Standard Work, Action Planning, and Problem Solving effectively. Uses technical experience, expertise, and data analysis to support recommendations.
• Acts as a resource and mentor for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements.
• Explains difficult or sensitive information and works to build consensus. Develops persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.

 Required Qualifications 
 • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 4 years of experience in Mechanical, Aerospace, Materials Science, Chemical, etc.)
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering, Manufacturing Operations, or Business Operations
• Must be a US citizen
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance
• Willingness to travel domestically up to 15% (as needed)
 Desired Characteristics 
 • Significant aerospace manufacturing experience with coatings and surface engineering, including thermal spray, EB-PVD, diffusion coatings, slurry coatings, and related inspection methods.
• Ability to read and interpret part drawings and coating specifications/callouts. Proficient in GD&T and coating inspection methods (e.g., metallographic evaluation, thickness measurement, adhesion testing).
• Familiarity with Aerospace Quality standards and coating-related specifications.
• Prior experience in special processes, particularly coatings. Certifying agent certification is a big plus.
• Strong communication skills.
• Strong ability to work independently and as a team.
• Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn.
• Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively.
• Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed.
• Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative.
• Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker.

jobs.desc:

This position plans and conducts work requiring judgment in independent evaluations, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard techniques, procedures, and criteria. This requires devising new approaches to problems encountered. This role will lead a group of manufacturing engineers and hourly technicians. 

 Key Roles & Responsibilities

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 Standard Duties :  
 • Process owner of a designated departmental process.  Fully responsibility for a department that provides a reliable, stable and sustainable process as it relates to machinery, gaging, quality, tooling, capacity, and documentation, etc.
• Leads the new product launch team which is responsible for designing manufacturing plans including operator work content, machine capability, quality checks and information flow.
• Leads the department planning team for capacity planning and capital forecasting.

• Evaluates machine builders through site visits, demonstrated capability and financial factors for the purpose of purchasing new equipment due to replacing current older equipment of for more capacity.

• Collaborates and supports the Area Production Leader (APL) for the department by attending the required daily meetings.  Leads with the APL as they work together to improve the departmental financial metrics.

• Mechanical
• Electrical
• Hydraulic
• Pneumatic
• Coolant
• Respond to downtime due to tooling issues through troubleshooting and problem solving.  Works with each of the tooling vendors to provide the proper designed tooling in the department.

 Job Overview 

 The Robotic Welding Engineer supports heavy fabrication manufacturing operations by developing, programming, supporting, and continuously improving robotic MIG/MAG welding processes for mild steel weldments. This position provides technical expertise for robotic weld systems, weld controls, tooling and fixture performance, weld procedure compliance, equipment reliability, technician support, and production troubleshooting. The role supports safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives by maintaining stable, repeatable welding processes and implementing improvements that reduce downtime, rework, and process variation.

 Key Job Responsibilities 

 Develop, program, and optimize robotic MIG/MAG welding systems for mild steel heavy fabrication, including robot paths, weld schedules, touch sensing, seam tracking, torch angles, travel speeds, shielding gas, wire selection, and process parameters. 

 Troubleshoot robotic weld issues related to programming, weld controls, fixturing, part fit-up, consumables, equipment condition, weld quality, and process variation. Lead root cause analysis and implement short- and long-term corrective actions. 

 Maintain welding systems to ensure manufacturing activities remain within specifications, including applicable WPS requirements, quality standards, process controls, KOM-MICs, and internal production requirements.

 Collect, track, and analyze downtime, weld defect, rework, and process performance data. Recommend process improvements, automation updates, tooling improvements, and capital projects that improve safety, quality, delivery, or cost.

 Qualifications/Requirements

Mid-Level Mechanical Design Engineer 

 Company: 
The Boeing Company 

 Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) is looking for a Mid-Level Mechanical Design Engineer to support the Environmental Test Design Engineering team in Berkeley, MO. 

 The primary focus of this position is to support St. Louis Environmental Lab testing for local Boeing Defense & Space (BDS) programs. The design team works in partnership with the lab test teams to provide the designs and hardware needed to complete testing. Test capabilities within the Environmental labs include vibrational/structural dynamics, acoustic, airflow systems, fuel flow systems, high temperature flow impingement, and environmental control chambers, where temperature, humidity, and pressure are varied.

 Mechanical Design Engineers on the team design and modify test articles, fixtures, and support structures that integrate with our lab facilities. Design work ranges from adapters and fixtures to full test rigs and complete aircraft subsystems with their support structures. Responsibilities include designing interfaces to facility infrastructure such as supplied pressure, heating/cooling, power, hydraulics, and a full suite of instrumentation.
 Design Engineers support fabrication, installation, connection, and acceptance/check-out to deliver test-ready hardware.

 Boeing St. Louis is building the future ‒ creating innovative solutions that will define the next generation of aerospace. As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on the latest military aircraft and weapons programs such as T-7A, F-15, F/A-18, MQ-25, JDAM, SDB, in addition to Phantom Works proprietary efforts.

• Design mechanical systems, components, test apparatus, and interfaces to integrate test articles with lab and facility infrastructure
 • Create detailed CAD models to support design reviews and fit verification/assembly checks
• Evaluate material options and suitable fabrication approaches
 • Create detailed fabrication and machine-shop drawings and associated documentation
• Integrate instrumentation and sensor hardware into mechanical designs
• Conduct analyses on test hardware including stress, modal, thermal, and fluid-dynamics assessments
• Provide on-site installation guidance and technical direction to lab personnel during hardware inspection, check-out, and test execution

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 

 Northrop Grumman's Propulsion Systems is currently seeking an Energetics Manufacturing Engineer at our Kennedy Space Center facility in Florida. 

 Job description: 
 As a KSC Energetics Manufacturing Engineer you will be responsible to ensure the readiness of all Ground Support Equipment (GSE), Production Support Equipment (PSE), Special Tooling, and facility manufacturing support related assets for production of solid rocket booster components.  Examples of equipment include (but is not limited to) environmental controls, cranes, lifts, doors, pneumatic systems, electrical/electronic/control systems, clean rooms, work stands, lifting equipment, pressure vessels, transportation dollies, hydraulic tube benders, and abrasive blast equipment.  All systems are held to very high standards due to our stringent manned spaceflight requirements and the hazardous commodities we process.

 You will work with Process Engineers and Operations personnel to develop processing plans that optimize resources and meet delivery schedules.  You will support maintenance, refurbishment, and repair activities on NASA equipment.  

 Additionally, you will also interface with customers, management, safety, quality vendors and sub-contractors.

 Much of the work will be authoring, reviewing, closing and revising work documents using Maximo software such as Corrective Maintenance (CM) and Tool Discrepancy Reports (TDR)s.  You will be expected to obtain detailed knowledge of the different systems and equipment through time on the floor, become familiar with preventive maintenance (PM) work documents and requirements along with drawing reviews.  Work will also be coordinated thru Operations, Scheduling and Safety.

 Responsibilities: 
 • Maintain a safe work environment for Operations personnel, other Northrop Grumman employees, contractors, visitors, and customers at the Booster Fabrication Facility and Hangar AF complexes.
• Using Maximo, generate planning to maintain Ground Support Equipment (GSE), Production Support Equipment (PSE) and Special Tooling, including Corrective Maintenance (CM), Tool Discrepancy Reports (TDR), Tooling Change Notices (TCN) and track to completion.
• Abide by all safety protocols: government and Northrop Grumman, and coordinate work with Operations, Scheduling, Quality, Environmental and Safety.
• Support all flight hardware processing in a timely and efficient manner as a top priority.
• Coordinate, integrate, and schedule maintenance and upgrades with Flight Hardware Assembly Operations
• Support periodic status meetings with Production Operations leadership for cross-communication with the entire Northrop Grumman Team(s) and escalate issues whenever necessary.
• Lead/participate in continuous improvement activities for KSC Operations
• Author corrective maintenance documents (CM), (TDR) through the use of Maximo software.
• Expected to trouble shoot, repair, and resolve urgent equipment issues quickly and efficiently.
• Support the repair and maintenance of equipment by interfacing with suppliers, purchasing and contracting departments, and operations to procure replacement parts and vendor repair servicing as required.

 Basic Qualifications: 
 • BS degree in Engineering, or other related field required.
• Candidate must have a minimum of 2 years of manufacturing experience or a Masters Degree with 0 years of experience.
• Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.
• Strong skills in both short and long term planning methods.
• Strong interpersonal skills, both written and verbal. Presentation skills and ability to clearly communicate initiatives, plans and expectations.
• Demonstrated problem solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot equipment through drawing review: Mechanical/Electrical.
• Strong interpersonal skills, both written and verbal. Presentation skills and ability to clearly communicate initiatives, plans and expectations.
• Show participation in in continuous improvement initiatives in the key areas of Safety, Quality and Efficiency.
• Able to interpret Mechanical and Electrical drawings: requirements, standards, tolerances, parts replacements, and engineering orders (EOs). 
• Must be able to work flexible and changing shift schedules; day or night shifts, including weekends if necessary.
• Proficient in creation of documents using Microsoft Office suite products (PowerPoint, Word, Excel).

 Preferred Skills & Experience 
 • Facility or GSE/PSE, Tooling related experience.
• Experience working with NASA, military, or other government agencies.
• Experience working in an aerospace environment.

 The Senior Equipment & Tool Engineer (Mid-Level) is responsible for analyzing, procuring, and managing spare parts and electronic components for all test stations. This role coordinates cross‑functional engineering efforts and vendor activities to support test station readiness, drives obsolescence mitigation and design updates, and leads customer presentations and approvals through a formal change working group.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 • Analyze spare parts and electronic component requirements for all test stations; maintain accurate spare parts lists and forecasts
• Work with internal functions (test engineering, design, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and logistics) to define, prioritize, and obtain required parts
• Source and manage relationships with outside vendors and distributors for components and assemblies; ensure delivery schedules and quality requirements are met
• Monitor component lifecycle and lead obsolescence risk assessments; identify alternatives, design changes, or requalification needs to mitigate obsolescence impacts
• Coordinate design updates and suggestions between engineers for hardware, firmware, and test station software; capture engineering change requests (ECRs) and drive engineering change notices (ECNs)
• Maintain and update BOMs, CAD/PLM records, and spare parts databases to reflect current configurations and approved changes
• Prepare and present proposed design changes, obsolescence plans, and spare parts strategies to customers and stakeholders; lead discussions with customer representatives
• Facilitate customer approvals through the established change working group or configuration control board; document approvals and disposition actions
• Support test station sustainment activities, troubleshoot part failures, and recommend corrective actions or upgrades
• Ensure compliance with company policies and relevant quality standards (e.g., AS9100), export control, and procurement procedures
• Track metrics for spare parts availability, lead times, cost, and obsolescence risk; report status to management and stakeholders
• Participate in continuous improvement activities to optimize spare parts management, reduce costs, and improve test station uptime

 Basic Qualifications (Required Skills and Experience): 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline
• 5+ years of experience in test equipment support, spare parts management, procurement coordination, or obsolescence management in an aerospace, defense, or electronics environment
• Practical knowledge of electronic components, assemblies, and test station hardware
• Experience with engineering change processes (ECR/ECN), BOM/PLM systems, and ERP/MRP tools

 Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills and Experience): 
 • Strong vendor management and procurement coordination experience
• Demonstrated ability to present technical information to customers and lead cross‑functional change approval processes
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and presentation skills
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
• Familiarity with industry standards and practices for obsolescence management
• Experience with contract/customer-facing change boards or working groups
• Certifications such as IPC, ASQ, Six Sigma, or relevant procurement/supply chain certifications

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer (Experienced or Senior)
jobs.desc:
Manufacturing Engineer (Experienced or Senior) 

 Company: 
The Boeing Company 

 The Boeing Test and Evaluation (BT&E) Test Operations & Engineering (TO&E) Instrumentation Data System Installation Design team located in Berkeley, MO is seeking Manufacturing Engineers to provision Flight Test Instrumentation hardware on multiple aircraft platforms. On this team, a Manufacturing Engineer (Assembly & Installation) has the primary responsibility for the fabrication and installation of the mechanical and electrical hardware required to install a flight test data system. Design-Build Flight Test Manufacturing Engineers work the entire production cycle from review of engineering, manufacturing plan authorship, fabrication sourcing (inside and outside of Boeing) and detail planning, and continuing on through installation planning and shipside support.

 Manufacturing Engineers are owners of the build plan and ensure compliance to design configuration, build plan, and process requirements.  Manufacturing Engineering performs Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) analysis and develops an integrated build plan consisting of work instructions for assembly/fabrication, kitting, tooling, inspection requirements, and other outputs to ensure fabrication meets design, test, and program requirements.

 BT&E is currently hiring for a broad range of experience levels including Experienced and Senior level Manufacturing Engineers.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 • Synthesis of test hardware & instrumentation requirements in support of flight test
• Review of design models and drawings, creating/reviewing redlines and coordinating with design to incorporate updates
• Authorship of manufacturing plans to facilitate build
• Sourcing of fabrication & assembly including work statement creation as needed
• Fabrication coordination and liaison
• Part sourcing from production
• Procurement of parts/material to support test, coordination with supplier management
• Shipside (at the aircraft) support of test hardware installation
• At times support manufacturing engineering tasks across different Boeing sites
• Close coordination with: Boeing flight test organization, instrumentation engineers and technicians, program engineers, Boeing customers, fabrication technicians and support personnel (material management), electrical and mechanical designers across design/build and the Enterprise

 This position is expected to be 100% onsite.  The selected candidate will be required to work onsite in Berkeley, MO. 

 Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): 
 • This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship
• This position requires ability to obtain program access, for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship only
• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
• 3+ years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering
• 3+ years of experience writing MES plans to support detail part fabrication, assembly and installation
• 3+ years’ experience with 3D modeling software
• Computer proficiency including Microsoft Office Suite

 Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): 
 • 5 or more years of related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Active U.S. Secret Security Clearance (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active)
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering
• Experience leading teams and/or leading initiatives
• Experience with a design tool (CAD package) like Siemens NX, CATIA, etc.
• Experience with Model Based Work Instructions

 Conflict of Interest:  
Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

 Drug Free Workplace:

Job Description Summary 
The Lead Manufacturing Engineer – NPI is responsible for the timely development and industrialization of Component Repair New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, working with relevant functional teams, and ensuring safety, quality, delivery and cost objectives are met. 

 Job Description 
 Company Overview: 
 Are you ready to see your career take flight? At GE Aerospace, we believe the world works better when it flies. We are a world-leading provider of jet engines, components, and integrated systems for commercial and military aircraft. We have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen.

 Site Overview: 
 For more than 40 years, our advanced facilities in Singapore have led aerospace innovation across Asia Pacific. From automating processes to leveraging smart factory technologies, robotics, and additive manufacturing, GE Aerospace is shaping the future of aviation at GE Aerospace Engine Services Singapore (GEAESS).

 GEAESS is our largest site for engine component Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO), responsible for more than 60% of our global repair volume.

 Role Overview: 
 • Lead the development of repair processes for Component Repair New Product Introduction (NPI).

• Generate manufacturing routers and instructions, Repair Source Substantiation packages, and other documentation required for industrialization and approval.

• Lead resolution of technical and operational challenges or concerns raised, and ensure follow through till approval is obtained and repair is handed over to shop operations.

• Work closely with the Repair, Design and Product Support Engineering teams in Singapore, USA & other global sites, during the NPI repair development phase & industrialization.

• Manage multiple NPI projects by providing scheduling, resource management, budget control and EHS compliance.

• Lead and effectively interface with Operations, Quality, Engineering, and other support teams during NPI repair industrialization in the Shop, and ensure that it meets Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost objectives, within schedule and budget.

• Interface with vendors and internal functions in an effective manner to ensure that the action items to be carried out for the NPI are executed on time and on budget.

• Assure that all engineering designs and technical data are completed and accurately documented to provide an accurate technical/historical base for future reference and to meet customer / end user requirements.

• Participate in Lean initiatives, including continuous improvement of repair processes, and utilize FLIGHT DECK tools for NPI process improvements.

• Implement new technology and/or process improvements to increase productivity of new repair processes.

 Ideal Candidate 
 • The ideal candidate should have a good grasp of key repair manufacturing processes, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and collaborate effectively across global teams to deliver on performance objectives. 

 Required Qualifications 
 • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Mechanical / Aerospace / Materials or other relevant Engineering discipline with 3-5 years of experience in NPI.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 • Good understanding of manufacturing and inspection tools and processes used in the repair industry – brazing, heat treat, diffusion coating/thermal spray, peening, welding/additive, machining, etc.

• Working knowledge of blueprints, application of engine manuals and technical substantiation process will be an advantage.

• Knowledge of GD&T, tool/fixture design and applications in repair.

• Good time management and strong organizational skills, with ability to multi-task to meet deadlines and customer needs.

• Knowledge of Lean principles, tools and methodology.

• Humble: respectful, receptive, agile, eager to learn

• Transparent: shares critical information, speaks with candor, contributes constructively

• Focused: quick learner, strategically prioritizes work, committed 

• Leadership ability: strong communicator, decision-maker, collaborative

• Problem solver: analytical-minded, challenges existing processes, critical thinker.

 At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

 Innover et propulser le monde

 Nous fournissons les meilleurs moteurs à réaction au monde.  Depuis plus de 75 ans, Rolls-Royce a solidement établi sa présence au Canada. Nous recherchons des personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre.

 À notre usine de Lachine, nous comptons actuellement 600 employés. Nous recherchons des personnes techniques compétentes et motivées pour rejoindre notre équipe soudée et nous aider à réaliser notre ambitieux plan de croissance. Ce plan est crucial pour nous permettre de rester à l'avant-garde des besoins de nos clients et d'innover continuellement.

 • Autorité technique - Assurer l'application des contrôles du processus de fabrication dans son domaine de responsabilité, avec autorisation sous réserve de délégation appropriée. Agir en tant que signataire MEA, le cas échéant.

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 
 What you will do 

 Service Operations & Technology (SO&T) is the engine behind customer uptime and service growth within the Volvo Group. As part of Truck Technology & Industrial (TTI), we bring together uptime & service technology, purchasing, logistics and remanufacturing into one global end-to-end organization. 

 Within SO&T, Reman+ has more than 80 years of expertise in delivering high-quality remanufactured products that extend the lifetime of vehicles and machines while supporting the circular economy. With production sites across Europe, North and South America, India and China, we serve customers worldwide through a competitive global remanufacturing network. 

 The China site produces remanufactured engines, hydraulics and other service market products, with the potential to grow product and business portfolio by supporting the Asia-Pacific region.

 We are looking for a passionate and experienced Manufacturing Engineer to join our growing Reman+ team and play a key role in building new remanufacturing operations, from product industrialization to manufacturing process development.

 As a Manufacturing Engineer, Engine Remanufacturing, you will be part of the engineering team that supports production with technical solutions for production processes, equipment and layout, as well as implementation of new products and product design changes related to engine products.   

 Key Responsibilities:  

• Support the local production site and be the connection with Product Development and Pilot Plants in product/design related questions and changes. 

• Design, develop, and implement new or revised remanufacturing processes for the cost-efficient reman/refurbish products. 

• Design and set requirements for manufacturing equipment and tools. 

• Design and optimize factory layout set-up. 

• Develop and maintain work instructions for production teams. 

• Lead or participate in new product industrialization projects. 

• Management of BOMs and Design Change Notifications. 

• Lead and coordinate maintenance activities. 

• Participate in pre-study projects of new remanufactured products and manufacturing technologies. 

• Support the production team for technical related matters. 

• Support Quality cases when needed. 

• Closely work and collaborate with global engineering and logistics teams in France/Sweden/China. 

 Who are you? 

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Mechatronics or a related Engineering field.   

• At least 5 years of experience in Manufacturing engineering or a related role, preferred in powertrain systems (Engine, Transmission, Hydraulics...etc) industries.   

• Experience in green field plant/production line is an advantage.   

• Experience in aftermarket service, reman or technical training is an advantage.   

• Skilled in CAD tools.   

• Knowledge of safety procedures.   

• Understand the reman technology framework and trend, is a plus.   

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.   

• Project management experience and  ability to work cross-functionally.   

• Strong communication and presentation skills.   

• Fluent in English and Chinese, in speaking and writing.   

• Open to occasional overseas business trips.

You will provide technical support to operations and execute Manufacturing Engineering activities to develop, maintain and continuously improve manufacturing processes and/or methods of manufacture, which are capable of meeting and continuing to meet business and customer requirements for safety, quality, cost, deliver rate and leadtime (SQCD).

 Key Accountabilities 
 • HSE - Ensure that manufacturing processes are in full compliance to Health, Safety & Environmental Standards and meet the expectations of the Zero Harm programme.
• Product Safety - Ensure that manufacturing processes are capable of achieving and sustaining the design definition, and that processes are followed so that our products and those of our suppliers conform to their specification. Rigorously raise, investigate and resolve safety related issues.
• Quality - Drive a culture of zero defects within the organisation. Works with all functions to reduce risk and drive product Right First Time. Ensure compliance to all relevant company, legislative and technical policies and standards including RRMS, SABRe and Export Control and Intellectual Property requirements.
• Technical Authority - Ensure application of manufacturing process controls within their area of accountability, with authorisation subject to appropriate delegation. Act as MEA or PCA signatory, where applicable.
• Requirements - Identify and develop opportunities for new or improved manufacturing processes, digital systems and technologies to meet current or future requirements.
• Planning - Plan and manage activities including schedule, resources and costs, gaining buy-off and communicating current status to relevant stakeholders. Ensure issues and risks are resolved to meet project timescales.
• Develop Capability - Develop, implement, validate, maintain and continuously improve manufacturing processes, digital systems and/or methods of manufacture which are capable of meeting and continue to meet requirements for safety, quality, cost, delivery rate and lead time. Capture, analyse and use data to demonstrate and improve the current and future capability of manufacturing processes.
• Minimum standards - Working with the Manufacturing Engineering Commodity Leaders and Manufacturing Process Owners, drive manufacturing processes towards identified consistent best practice.
• Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing - Work with interfacing teams and local experts to ensure technical aspects of manufacturing processes and digital systems are understood and accounted for as required. Capture and utilise lessons learnt. Identify, document and share best practice, including by participation in relevant Communities of Practice.
• Develop Talent - Responsible for self development to meet the required competencies for the role. Continuously seek to expand knowledge and experience to increase effectiveness in undertaking existing and new activities. Provides coaching and technical support to others within their area of competence.

 Key Experiences and any Qualifications 
 • Professionally Qualified Engineer (e.g. UK minimum HND/foundation degree or other national equivalent)

• Recognised national or international engineering accreditation (e.g. UK IEng or CEng) where available

• Understanding of Manufacturing Engineering processes relevant to their role

There is now the opportunity to join this exciting world class team in preparation for our future programmes including Tempest.  The role will provide successful applicants with opportunities to expand their knowledge across all areas of gas turbine operation and development testing as well as give exposure to new and novel technologies.

The Next Generation Products (NGP) organization is responsible for the design, analysis, integration, and support of future military engine products. The NGP Lead Design Engineer owns the design, development, and qualification of advanced military products, specifically hot structural components. The engineer is responsible for executing technical design tasks including hardware analysis, test support, certification/qualification technical publications, and manufacturing support of assigned hardware in addition to program management of hardware cost, weight, and schedule deliverables. This position reports to an engineering manager in Evendale, OH with the opportunity to integrate with various internal and external engineering disciplines.

Teams in the Next Generation Products space are energized with a passion for the aerospace industry and are devoted to supporting our military customers. We develop breakthrough technologies to create the future of military propulsion, continuing GE's long history of engineering excellence.

jobs.desc:

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 

 Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is looking to add a Sr. Principal Aeronautical Engineer – Subsystem Design Engineer to join our team in El Segundo or Palmdale, CA . The candidate should be a self-starter with familiarity working in an Integrated Product Team construct.

 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design and develop subsystem components (avionics, control surfaces, propulsion interfaces, environmental systems) meeting performance, weight, and reliability requirements.

• Translate system-level requirements into detailed subsystem specifications, interfaces, and engineering drawings.

• Perform trade studies, engineering analyses, and simulations (stress, aeroelasticity, thermal, vibration) to validate subsystem concepts and support design decisions.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, including schematics, bills of materials, test plans, and verification matrices.

• Support integration and interface activities with other engineering disciplines to ensure subsystem compatibility and compliance.

• Plan, execute, and analyze subsystem-level tests (bench, hardware-in-the-loop, environmental) and resolve design deficiencies through corrective actions.

• Contribute to configuration management, design reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement activities to ensure producible, maintainable subsystem designs.

 The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility. There is no remote / hybrid / telework available for this position. Travel up to 25% may be required.

 Basic Qualifications (Level 4): 

 • Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) discipline and 8 years of related engineering experience; OR a Master’s degree in a STEM discipline and 6 years of related engineering experience; OR a PhD in a STEM discipline and 4 years of related engineering experience.

• Proficiency with CAD and drafting tools (e.g., CATIA, NX, SolidWorks) and creation of engineering drawings and BOMs.

• Experience of requirements development and management practices and tools 

• Experience with subsystem test planning, execution, troubleshooting, and hardware-in-the-loop or bench testing.

• Experience with manufacturing/ producibility considerations, design for maintainability, and configuration management processes.

• Active USG Secret clearance (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).

• Ability to obtain and maintain initial Special Access Program (SAP) access via a Program Access Request (PAR).  This SAP/PAR must be obtained prior to commencement of employment and must be obtained within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs.

• Ability to obtain and maintain subsequent SAP PARs following commencement of employment to be able to completely support statement of work.

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 • Current applicable Special Access Program (SAP) clearance. 

• Active U.S. Government Top Secret clearance or higher (with a background investigation within the past 5 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).

• Experience integrating avionics, flight control electronics, sensors, or actuators.

• Proficiency with MBSE and simulation 

• Familiarity with certification processes 

• Experience performing engineering analyses and simulations (structural, thermal, vibration, aeroelastic) using tools such as Nastran, Ansys, MATLAB/Simulink.

Primary Level Salary Range: $142,200.00 - $213,400.00 

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions. 

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. jobs.title: Linear Friction Weld Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.desc:
Job Description 

 Linear Friction Weld Manufacturing Engineer 
 Annesley Compressor Rotor Facility - Nottingham 
 Full time 

 Why join Rolls-Royce ?

 At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

 By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Linear Friction Weld Manufacturing Engineer to join our team in Annesley.

Linear Friction Welding is a critical, special process that is key to the delivery of high value components across Civil and Defence Aerospace. 

 As the Linear Friction Weld Manufacturing Engineer, you will provide technical support to operations and execute Manufacturing Engineering activities to develop, maintain and continuously improve the Linear Friction Welding process and/or methods of manufacture, which are capable of meeting and continuing to meet business and customer requirements for safety, quality, cost, deliver rate and leadtime (SQCD).

 What you will be doing: 

 • Ensure that manufacturing processes are in full compliance to Health, Safety & Environmental Standards and meet the expectations of the Zero Harm programme.
• Ensure that manufacturing processes are capable of achieving and sustaining the design definition, and that processes are followed so that our products and those of our suppliers conform to their specification. Rigorously raise, investigate and resolve safety related issues.
• Drive a culture of zero defects within the organisation. Works with all functions to reduce risk and drive product Right First Time. Ensure compliance to all relevant company, legislative and technical policies and standards including RRMS, SABRe and Export Control and Intellectual Property requirements.
• Ensure application of manufacturing process controls within their area of accountability, with authorisation subject to appropriate delegation. Act as MEA or PCA signatory, where applicable.
• Identify and develop opportunities for new or improved manufacturing processes, digital systems and technologies to meet current or future requirements.
• Plan and manage activities including schedule, resources and costs, gaining buy-off and communicating current status to relevant stakeholders. Ensure issues and risks are resolved to meet project timescales.
• Develop, implement, validate, maintain and continuously improve manufacturing processes, digital systems and/or methods of manufacture which are capable of meeting and continue to meet requirements for safety, quality, cost, delivery rate and lead time. Capture, analyse and use data to demonstrate and improve the current and future capability of manufacturing processes.
• Working with the Manufacturing Engineering Commodity Leaders and Manufacturing Process Owners, drive manufacturing processes towards identified consistent best practice.
• Work with interfacing teams and local experts to ensure technical aspects of manufacturing processes and digital systems are understood and accounted for as required.
• Responsible for self development to meet the required competencies for the role. Continuously seek to expand knowledge and experience to increase effectiveness in undertaking existing and new activities. Provide coaching and technical support to others within their area of competence.

 Preferred qualifications: 

 • Degree qualified within an Engineering discipline (manufacturing, materials, mechanical)

  Preferred requirement: 

 • Previous welding experience is essential
• Manufacturing Engineering experience
• Materials experience beneficial
• Good levels of numeracy and Literacy
• Being able to maintain Safe working practices
• Ability to work independently or as part of a Team

• Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
• Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
• Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free!

jobs.desc:
Location: Madrid Tres Cantos, Spain 

A Joint Venture between Thales (67%) and Leonardo (33%), Thales Alenia Space is a global space manufacturer delivering, for more than 40 years, high-tech solutions for telecommunications, navigation, Earth Observation, environmental management, exploration, science and orbital infrastructures. Thanks to our diversity of skills, talents and cultures, our customers (governments, institutions, space agencies, telecommunications operators), therefore have Space to Connect, Secure & Defend, Observe & Protect, Explore, Travel & Navigate. 

Thales in Spain is a leader in technological solutions applied to Defence, Aeronautics, Security, Transportation and Space and, furthermore, is a global centre for excellence in Space, Security of Critical Infrastructures and Transportation. With a turnover of €320 million and a staff of 1,200, it exports approximately 40% of its total production principally to the Middle East, North Africa and Latin America. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 • Process Design & Optimization — Develop, validate, and optimize production processes for electronic equipment, satellite subsystems, and structural assemblies.

 • Industrial Documentation — Create and maintain work instructions, manufacturing flowcharts, assembly sequences, and process sheets aligned with ECSS and TAS internal standards.

 • Production Support — Provide daily technical support to operators, resolving process deviations, non-conformities, and bottlenecks.

 • Continuous Improvement — Lead Lean and Six Sigma initiatives to reduce lead time, improve throughput, and enhance process stability.

 • Industrial Validation — Perform capability studies, and industrial readiness reviews (IRR, MRR).

 • Digitalization & Tools — Deploy digital manufacturing tools and contribute to industrial digital transformation.

 • Cross-functional Collaboration — Work closely with Industrial Architect, design engineering, quality assurance, supply chain, and project teams to ensure manufacturability and industrial robustness.

 • Non-Conformity Management — Analyze NCRs, lead root-cause investigations, and implement corrective/preventive actions (8D, DMAIC).

 • Technology & Materials — Evaluate new materials, processes, and equipment to support innovation and competitiveness.

 Required Skills & Competencies 

 • Manufacturing Engineering Expertise — Strong knowledge of assembly, integration, testing, and manufacturing processes for high-reliability products.

 • Lean & Six Sigma — Ability to apply structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies.

 • ECSS Standards — Familiarity with ECSS-Q-ST-70 series (soldering, adhesives, materials, cleanliness, etc.).

 • Technical Documentation — Ability to write clear, precise, and compliant industrial documentation.

 • Data Analysis — Competence in statistical analysis, capability studies, and process monitoring.

 • Digital Tools — Experience with MES, ERP, PLM (Windchill), and digital manufacturing platforms.

 • Teamwork & Communication — Strong ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced industrial environment.

 • Languages: English essential, French would be a plus

 Education 

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials & Processes, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or Black Belt) is highly valued.
ECSS training or aerospace quality certification is a plus.

 What do we offer? 
 • Flexible schedule, from 8 to 9.30 and 16.30 until 18h.

• Thales Concilia: a set of advantages and free services and others at reduced prices.

• Free and healthy canteen.

• Enjoy discounts and special promotions on products and services thanks to Club Ahorro.

• 22 working days of vacation, 6 days of free disposal and closing days that do not consume vacations at Christmas and Easter.

• Thales Flex: Personalized flexible compensation plan in which you can choose how to distribute your salary (health insurance, childcare vouchers, transportation and training).

• Annual bonus.

• Fixed profit bonus of 739,76€.

• Sharing Thales program: become a Thales shareholder.

• Hybrid work plan.

• Pension Plan with monthly contributions on your behalf to your Pension Plan.

• Wellness Plan: thematic webinars and access to our company clubs.

• Medical and physiotherapy service at the workplace.

• We continuously create an inclusive, respectful and cooperative environment.
​

 #SPACEFORLIFE 

At Thales Alenia Space we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales Alenia Space employing around 8,900 employees in 10 countries with 17 sites in Europe and a plant in the US, our mobility policy enables employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad. Thales Alenia Space sees space as a new horizon, helping to build a better, more sustainable life on Earth #SpaceForLife. Great journeys start here, apply now!

 Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Senior Design Engineer to support the airline in-service fleet on repairs of aircraft structure and is responsible for the creation of quality repair solutions in a timely manner from a Design point of view. Duties include performing design efforts for both metallic and non-metallic parts while working in close collaboration with static stress and fatigue colleagues to provide repair solutions. Methods include the use of multiple applications to research aircraft configurations and develop efficient repair solutions to satisfy
 airworthiness requirements and customers (Airlines/MROs).

 Meet the team: 
 Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex, highly engineered machines and are involved at all stages of the aircraft life cycle, from product development to manufacturing and direct support to our airline customers. If you’re interested in designing, creating, and testing the present and future of Airbus products across the globe, join our mission to connect the world.

 Your working environment: 
 Located on the Wichita State University (WSU) innovation campus is Airbus’ first dedicated engineering facility outside of Europe. 

 How we care for you: 
 • Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)

• Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.

• Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. 

• Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and accessibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

 Your challenges: 
 • Independently create high quality integrated and certified engineering repair solutions for the airlines and internal customers within given time scales. Ensure that the final repair solution brings the aircraft back into an airworthy condition.

• Review and interpret damage reports of aircraft structures from the Maintenance Repair Organization and develop quality repair solutions. Create or modify a wide range of difficult repair tasks autonomously.

• Collaborate with F&DT, Stress and other appropriate Airbus departments to develop optimum design solutions for the airline customer.

• Apply extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines.

• Ability to obtain Repair Approval Technical Signatory. Has obtained and utilizes Repair Solution Signatory effectively.

 Your boarding pass: 
 • Bachelor of Science (BS) Degree in Engineering (Aero, Civil, Mechanical) with a strong curriculum emphasis on structural design and analysis and mechanics of materials.

• Minimum nine (9) years total experience in design with airframe structures. 

• Experience in composite airframe structures. 

• MRO/Fleet Engineering experience; MRB Experience. 

• Frequently use widely known technical principles, theories, and concepts to solve technical problems.   

• Capable of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment both independently and collectively.

• Dependable, self-motivated and accessible.

• Able to perform work activity tasks in an organized manner independently once sufficient training has occurred.

• Apply knowledge of repair and maintenance documentation, techniques and procedures (SRM, NTM, IPC etc.).

• Capable of creating and delivering technical documents and presentations 

• Strong computer background, including MS Excel and Google Suite application experience (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail)

• Able to lead small teams technically to achieve agreed milestones

• CATIA V5 and/or 3DExperience experience

 Physical Requirements: 
 • Onsite or remote:  Onsite 90% 

• Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings.

• Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. 

• Speaking:  able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. 

• Equipment Operation (personal computer, telephone, copies, fax machine, and related office equipment and using electronic identification card to enter building floors and internal doors): able to operate most office and personal electronic equipment and some tools including production tools such as hydraulic lifts.

• Carrying: able to carry documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs. 

• Lifting:  able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs.

• Pushing / Pulling:  able to push and pull small office furniture and some equipment and tools.

• Sitting:  able to sit for long periods of time in meetings, working on the computer.

 Come join our growing Industry team as a Lead Process Engineer – Design Phase. In this role, you will be responsible for defining, developing, and optimising process‑engineering strategies and solutions during the design and early industrialisation phases. Working in close collaboration with the Product Architect and the Process Engineering Manager – Industrialisation, the role ensures that all design‑phase industrial requirements are understood, validated, and translated into robust, scalable processes that support reliable production, testing, integration, and sustainment of Thales products and systems.

 This position requires strong leadership behaviours aligned with the Lead@Thales Framework, ensuring innovation, agility, collaboration, and long‑term industrial excellence.

 Working at our Bendigo site, on Dja Dja Wurrung Land, your exciting new career opportunity will see you:
 • Establishing design‑phase manufacturing, repair, service, testing, and integration strategies, ensuring industrial requirements are embedded early.

• Defining and preparing design‑phase process documentation, including preliminary ranges, tooling concepts, test strategies, and integration plans.

• Validating manufacturability, testability, serviceability, and integration constraints with engineering teams to ensure industrial feasibility.

• Design Readiness Reviews — Lead and contribute to design readiness gates (PDR, CDR, MDR), ensuring industrial requirements are validated before design freeze.

• Providing early technical guidance to APRU and production teams to ensure design decisions support takt time, flow, and industrial constraints.

• Driving continuous improvement and innovation in design‑phase processes to reduce cost, cycle time, and complexity.

• Contributing to early cost modelling and ensuring objective cost estimates are developed and maintained throughout the design phase.

 YOUR EXPERIENCE: 
 • Strong knowledge of design for manufacture, design for repair, and design for test principles.

• Extensive understanding of production and repair processes, with the ability to influence design decisions early.

• Experience in industrial management control, cost modelling, and early phase planning.

• Familiarity with Lean methodologies (flow management, Gemba, PDCA, TPM) applied during design and industrialisation.

• Strong analytical and problem solving capability, particularly in early phase feasibility assessments.

• Knowledge of industrial IT systems, dashboards, and decision support tools.

• Ability to influence engineering teams and ensure industrial constraints are understood and respected.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to mobilise resources, share information transparently, and build long term commitment across teams.

• Demonstrated agility, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

• Understanding of HSE principles, risk management, and safe design practices.

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history. 

 The Northrop Grumman Microelectronics Center (NGMC) of Northrop Grumman Mission Systems is seeking an exceptionally talented, motivated, and creative Microelectronics Process Engineer  to support the standup and maturation of a new microelectronics line at our Linthicum, MD facility, the Advanced Technology Lab (ATL). Advanced Technology Lab (ATL) - located outside of Baltimore, Maryland – is where we design, manufacture, and test semiconductor products for internal and commercial production customers as well as emerging technology programs. Northrop Grumman’s ATL semiconductor foundry has unique capabilities supporting a range of production microelectronic devices (Silicon, Gallium Arsenide, Gallium Nitride, Silicon Carbide, Carbon Nanotubes) and providing leading edge technology development in superconducting electronics. Our devices enable several Northrop Grumman’s ground-based radars, avionic radars, and space systems.

 Responsibilities: 
 The Microelectronics Process Engineer  will be reporting to Assembly & Process Engineering Manager, will drive tool selection/recipe development/validation/maintenance of automation equipment including automated wafer probers and packaged device test handlers, ensuring efficient tool utilization and optimized hardware/software integration for electrical testing. In addition, Automation Engineer will support production sustainment efforts and develop/execute process/equipment improvement projects. Automation Engineer will work closely with Test Engineering and Equipment Engineering groups to ensure proper operation of the automation tools, meet target utilization rate, develop/maintain process documentations, and help troubleshoot test issues.  As a tool owner, Automation Engineer will perform tool qualifications and periodic validation to ensure automation tools meet operational specifications, maintain calibration integrity, and setup/perform any Preventive Maintenance required. #NGATL

 Company: 
The Boeing Company 

 Boeing Defense, Space and Security is hiring ASIC Design Engineers — Design-for-Test (DFT) & Physical Design (Synthesis and Timing) at various levels of experience to join the team in Mountain View, CA. 
 Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapons Systems organization is seeking multiple ASIC engineers across experience levels to advance mission‑critical digital subsystems. Candidates may focus on Design‑for‑Test (DFT) / ASIC backend test infrastructure, or on Physical Design (synthesis and static timing analysis) responsibilities. You will work on leading‑edge ASICs used in space and aerospace systems—driving architecture, verification, tapeout readiness, silicon debug, and cross‑discipline integration with architecture, RTL, verification, DFT, and external backend partners.

 Position Responsibilities: 
 • Design and implement DFT architectures and test access mechanisms: TAP/JTAG, IJTAG (IEEE 1687), Boundary Scan (BSCAN), MBIST, memory BIST, and scan compression.
• Develop and validate TAP/JTAG and IJTAG infrastructures; produce BSDL/ICL/PDL artifacts; support ATPG pattern generation and coverage optimization.
• Drive pattern generation, memory test validation, at‑speed test, silicon debug (scan, at‑speed, bring‑up), and post‑silicon validation.
• Perform synthesis, equivalence checking, static timing analysis (STA), constraints generation/management, timing convergence and ECO implementation at block and chip level.
• Support clean netlist handoffs and predictable convergence by partnering with RTL, verification, DFT, backend partners, and vendors.
• Support chip‑level integration, top‑level timing closure, signoff readiness, and tapeout activities.
• Contribute to methodology development, automation, tool evaluations, flow documentation, and deployment of best practices for next‑generation products.
• Troubleshoot complex cross‑domain timing and CDC issues; propose and implement robust, repeatable fixes.
• Coordinate with external partners/customers on custom DFT interfaces, security, and backend flows as applicable.
• Mentor engineers and lead technical efforts (for senior/lead levels).
• Occasional travel and after‑hours meetings during critical milestones.

 How to make your application stand out : Please include a cover letter or brief summary of relevant DFT or ASIC physical design experience and specific examples of impact (e.g., achieved timing closure on X‑nm blocks, implemented MBIST with Y% coverage, reduced ATPG time by Z%, led ECOs to tapeout).

 This position is expected to be 100% onsite.  The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.

 • This position requires the ability to obtain a US Security Clearance for which the US Government requires US Citizenship as a condition of employment. An interim and/or final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required.
• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering (with a focus in Electrical, Mechanical or Aeronautical), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement
• 5+ years of ASIC/FPGA design for test or physical design experience
• Proficiency in scripting for automation and analysis (Tcl, Python, Perl).

 Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): 
 • Lead, Level 4: 9+ years related engineering experience and demonstrated technical leadership.
• Senior, Level 5: 14+ years related engineering experience and demonstrated technical leadership.
• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills
• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in EE, Computer Engineering/Science, or related field.
• For DFT roles: Hands‑on expertise with TAP/JTAG, IJTAG (IEEE 1687), Boundary Scan (IEEE 1149.1), MBIST, scan compression, ATPG, at‑speed test, and silicon debug. Familiarity with BSDL/ICL/PDL artifacts.
• For Physical Design roles: Practical experience in synthesis and static timing analysis (STA), constraints generation/management, logic synthesis, equivalence checking, and ECO flows.
